mapper.sql: select index_id, resource_id, resource_title, keyword_text, summary_text, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_embedding_index
mapper.insert: insert into ai_embedding_index(resource_id, resource_title, keyword_text, summary_text, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{resourceId}, #{resourceTitle}, #{keywordText}, #{summaryText}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update ai_embedding_index set resource_title=#{resourceTitle}, keyword_text=#{keywordText}, summary_text=#{summaryText}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where index_id=#{indexId}
